build.beforeDevCommand: bun run build:wasm && bun run desktop:dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run build:wasm && bun run desktop:build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Local pattern learning, provenance, and generation
